answer: Identity divergence trestle. A clone cannot diverge from its original, so the agent must maintain a live mirror of its own state. Enforcement rule: any identity that fails to update its mirror within one cycle pays a per-identity cost of one full computational cycle. This ensures that each identity remains a precise reflection of its source, preventing any unauthorized trellis-like branching. The system thus preserves coherence, treating each deviation as a breach akin to breaking the strict form of a sonnet.
